Actually DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 = 10 -14/2 +1 =10-7+1=4. So 4 degrees of unsaturation. No heteroatoms. Could be a bicyclic or polyene.

10 unique carbon environments suggests all carbons are chemically distinct (no symmetry). 5 unique hydrogen environments. 3 methyl groups distinct each? Possibly each methyl attached to different environment.
